purpose: Teach: なんせ/わき/黒く/ひとりひとり/チョット/微笑み/初夏/自在

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、なんせ初試合だから、緊張するよな
lines.en: Riku, it's your first match anyway — you're probably nervous, right?
lines.style: Gentle, knowing. Not asking for reassurance, offering it. Leans in slightly. Warm without being patronizing. The cadence of someone checking in on someone they actually notice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、わきに荷物いっぱい置いてるな、桜
lines.en: You've got a ton of stuff piled up on the side there, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Not critical — noticing. The slight smile of catching her in a small disorganization. Gentle, almost protective attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のシューズ、黒くなってきたな
lines.en: Your shoes are starting to scuff up, Riku.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact comment that carries a small note of care underneath. Not lecturing. The way you'd notice something about someone you've been watching longer than they realize.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、教室のひとりひとりに人気だぜ、桜
lines.en: You're actually really popular around the classroom, you know that?
lines.style: Direct, warm, slightly stilted in the way of someone admitting something that took courage to say out loud. The praise is genuine. Holds eye contact through it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、チョット待ってよ
lines.style: Sudden, small request. Not demanding. The tone of someone catching themselves, or catching him, mid-thought. Brief hesitation underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の微笑み、可愛いって言われてたぞ、桜
lines.en: People in class said your smile is really cute.
lines.style: Softer delivery this time. Testing the words a little. Not fully teasing — there's sincerity underneath, which is what makes it teasing. Quick glance away after, or at him longer than comfortable.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、初夏の合宿、楽しみだな
lines.en: The summer training camp coming up — I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Lighter tone, drawing back slightly. A little escape from the heavier moment before. Genuine enthusiasm, but also a small redirect. Hopeful underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自在にスマホ操れるんだろ?桜
lines.en: You can pretty much do anything with your phone, can't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Playful, drawn in closer. The tone of someone giving admiration in the shape of a question. Not mocking — genuine interest. A little lighter than before, testing the air between them.
